remarks: Luxury 1BR/1BA Condo with Breathtaking Views at The Biltmore!  Soaring floor-to-ceiling windows in this 16th-floor condo offer spectacular panoramic views of downtown Stamford, stretching all the way to Long Island Sound! Located in the heart of the city, this bright and spacious 1-bedroom home features an open layout, an open kitchen with white cabinetry, a generously sized living area flooded with natural light and a large bedroom with walk-in closet. The iconic Biltmore luxury condominium offers top-tier amenities, including a 24-hour concierge, state-of-the-art fitness center, community/party room, pet-friendly spaces, a beautifully landscaped 4th-floor terrace, and same-day dry cleaning. Commuters will love the shuttle service to Metro-North and easy access to highways, shopping, dining, and entertainment. Garage parking available (additional cost) or convenient parking nearby.  This move-in ready unit is a rare find! Move-in cost $300. Two months' security deposit. Excellent credit & sufficient income required. Don't miss out-schedule your tour today!
